name: Doppelganger

source.note: The 2024 Doppelganger. Every number compared with the page fetched from aidedd.org. Slam's Advantage during the first round of each combat is text only. Shape-Shift is listed under forms with one disguise shape; the engine does not yet fix its Humanoid size to Medium or Small.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.summary: Two Slam attacks, and Unsettling Visage if it is ready.

actions.name: Slam
actions.summary: A hard blow; it attacks with Advantage in the first round of each combat.
actions.text: Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. It has Advantage on the attack roll during the first round of each combat (text only for the engine).

actions.name: Read Thoughts
actions.summary: Casts Detect Thoughts (Charisma, DC 12) with no components.
actions.text: The doppelganger casts Detect Thoughts, needing no spell components and using Charisma as its spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12).

actions.name: Unsettling Visage
actions.summary: Recharge 6. DC 12 Wis save for each creature within 15 ft that sees it, or Frightened (a save at the end of each of its turns; a minute at most).
actions.text: Wisdom saving throw, DC 12, each creature that can see the doppelganger within a 15-foot Emanation around it. Failure: Frightened; the target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success, and succeeds automatically after 1 minute.

bonus_actions.name: Shape-Shift
bonus_actions.summary: Takes the form of a Small or Medium Humanoid, or returns to its true form.
bonus_actions.text: The doppelganger turns into a Medium or Small Humanoid, or back into its true form. Its statistics other than size stay the same in each form, and what it wears or carries does not change.

shapes.name: Disguise
shapes.summary: The Humanoid it passes as (Small or Medium): its statistics stay the same.

summary: A shapeshifter that hits twice with its fists, rattles a crowd with a frightening face, and reads minds to pass for anyone.
